create_world_instance: create a World instance with optional observations and an initialize_fn for probabilistic programming
initialize_world_with_queries: initialize a World with query nodes and observations, retrying up to max_retries for valid state
get_node_value: get the sampled tensor value for a given RVIdentifier node from the World
replace_world_values: replace values for specific nodes in the World and update the dependency graph accordingly
compute_log_prob: compute the joint log probability of all or a subset of nodes in the World
